_about: Bracketology (NCAA men's tournament) settings. autoBid: per conference, 'placeholder' (the regular-season standings leader takes the automatic bid) or 'model' (simulate the conference tournament). Ben's call, conference by conference, from data/bracket_autobid_backtest.json - nothing here flips on its own. formatOverride: a conference's tournament shape as bracket tiers (teams entering at each round, worst seeds first), for a league whose last three tournaments no longer describe it. selectionSunday: per season; a season not listed uses the Sunday on or after March 11.
